scope: one saved final grid/toy scratch CPU prototype, no production or quality qualification
sample_selection: every odd real row, including zero direction; no odd importance weights
old_count_use: fresh raw pvalues rethresholded at the common cutoff, clean-table descriptive only, no iid authority
pair_eligibility: both originals and offspring finite, p>Q, no support flag, inside in BOTH views, own category retained, shared real group
ordinary_budget: floor(Q*N)-saved last ordinary moves; grid empty prefix, toy exhausted prefix; no inferred missing reservation IDs
parent_child_work: max64 parents/max64 children per signature; at most residual budget pairs and one jitter matrix; no retries
objective: sum even-group empirical mass times squared even-clipped-mean minus EMA-clipped-mean residual
noise: one private cloned saved CPU-state stream, shared draw and own original bounded latent geometry per table; no emitted output-noise draws
commit: exact ephemeral content-digested packet, epoch+postdraw stream+bandwidth pinned, all validation before writes, scratch-only
states: raw saved FAST/EMA host adapters, no trainer serve swap; original states and global/owned saved RNG unchanged
production_orchestration: not implemented; future mean phase must refresh caches/moved_rows/ordinary totals and existing reset/rebase/serving posthooks
